name: MS-01
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Trent Kelly running with large cash advantage
No polling or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The R+18 district lean plus Kelly's incumbency and roughly two-to-one fundraising edge leave Johnson with no visible path; markets price Kelly near 95%. With no polls or expert ratings to the contrary, the forecast stays close to the fundamentals.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing Johnson within single digits, or a surge of outside spending, would warrant moving this toward Likely R.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
North Mississippi's 1st District is a solidly Republican seat, and incumbent Trent Kelly is seeking another term after easily securing his party's nomination. Democrat Cliff Johnson, a former state legislator, has raised a modest sum and faces a steep structural disadvantage in a district that favored Republicans by about 18 points at the presidential level.

Kelly has out-raised Johnson roughly two to one and holds a large cash-on-hand lead, while prediction markets give him about a 95% chance of winning. With no public polling and no expert ratings flagging the race, the forecast treats this as safely Republican, with Johnson needing an unforeseen shift to make it competitive.
